label: pair claw of aburan28/cryptanalysis#175 against the strong signed-Frobenius rho, same targets, six Koblitz curves
description: PROTOCOL.md. claw.pair_table (native port of the four-point signed-Frobenius quotient pair-table search with a known-log orbit base) at the cost-minimising shape (c = 1) and at the PR's n=83 shape (base_scale 1.06, table_scale 1/32), against rho.signed_frobenius_strong on the same one-target workloads, with bsgs.negation as the generic-table comparator and an A/A control.
